Where & Why It Breaks

This page will cover the recurring breakpoints: the interim-to-permanent housing bottleneck, exits back into homelessness, interagency handoff failures, data siloing between HMIS and provider systems, staffing/turnover in outreach and case management, and the mismatch between funding cycles and the time housing actually takes to build or lease up.
